note: Waiting state: operating day 2026-11-26 runs 26 Nov 00:00 to 24:00 CT and nothing has linked yet (no outcome stage exists), so the gates' stamps and the pylon's 96 rows are hatched, never zero. Real: the 24 hours along the lane are Desert Willow's sealed arm C (showcase.arms.C.kw: discharge teal, charge #7f9cc0, filled to its share of 150 MW) over each hour's price in the plan's own forecast at DSWL_BES1 (showcase.forecast.node_da_cents, day-type persistence), on the kit's price scale (0.14 m a $/MWh): $13.22 at 11 am (the valley it charges in) to $36.12 at 5 pm (the peak it discharges on). These are forecasts, not settled prices; real-time prices arrive as the day runs. The pylon's strip is the same schedule. The submission closes 2026-11-26 20:00:00 CT (2026-11-27 09:00:00 Bangkok), before the day ends, so a submission shows real-time rows up to about 20:00 CT and says the day is still running. Illustrative: the gates, pylon, lights and Parc Ferme's plate, ticks (316, the sealed leaf count) and glow; the comets carry no figure. Render again when stage 1 links.
